Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (model fit / benchmarks)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for taking the time earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Key goals: embed fast, cost-effective LLM responses for customer support triage and KYC screening with 99th-pct latency targets under 300ms for 512-token responses.
- Constraints: PII retention policy, preferred deploy in us-west region, and SOC2 evidence required for procurement.
- Early model candidates we discussed: Llama-3-13B-int8 and Redmond-7B-qat. We recommended testing both for quality and TPS cost tradeoffs.

Next steps:
1) We’ll run a quick model-fit eval on your prompt set and return Redwood-verified performance profiles (latency percentiles, throughput/TPS, and token-cost estimates). See attached prompt set we used (fintech_prompt_set_v1.csv).
2) We'll share a dashboard link with benchmark runs and a short report (attached PDF) and flag any quality regressions vs baseline.
3) Schedule a follow-up to review results — proposing Mon 16 Mar, 10am PT.

Deliverable timeline: benchmarks + report by EOD Fri 13 Mar.

If that all looks good I’ll proceed.

Best,
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 07:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (model fit / benchmarks)

Looping in some quick notes on the eval run I kicked off this morning — ran both Llama-3-13B-int8 and Redmond-7B-qat against the provided fintech_prompt_set_v1.csv and a small held-out baseline set (Prod-Lite-3B outputs). Highlights so far (preliminary):

- Llama-3-13B-int8: 95th-pct latency ~210ms, 99th-pct ~310ms on our us-west gpus with continuous batching at 8 concurrent requests. TPS stable at ~18 req/s for 512-token window. Quality roughly on par with baseline on intent classification prompts but some truncation on long KYC examples.
- Redmond-7B-qat: 95th-pct latency ~140ms, 99th-pct ~220ms, TPS ~34 req/s. Quality slightly lower on nuanced entity extraction; better cost profile.
- Token-cost estimates: Llama-3-13B-int8 ~ $0.009 per 1k tokens served; Redmond-7B-qat ~ $0.0045 per 1k tokens.

I’m attaching the full Redwood-verified benchmark PDF and the raw run link. I flagged two prompt examples where Llama-3-13B-int8 had hallucination-like outputs vs baseline — see comments in the report.

I’ll be on the call Monday to walk through the dashboard and recommend a safe canary configuration (pin to Redmond-7B-qat for triage, fallback to Llama-3-13B-int8 for higher-fidelity cases).

Thanks,
Dev
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

- Performance profiles (Redwood-verified): see dashboard link for percentile breakdowns (p50/p95/p99) and request-per-second scaling curves.

- Procurement pack: SOC2 evidence and AICPA contact are in the shared Drive link; happy to pull a bundled packet for you.
